programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha Daolag-bhreac air bhioran – an e àite draoidheil a tha seo? E fèir mìorbhaileach! Daolag-bhreac is excited - is this a magic place? It’s just amazing!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mossy air bhioran gus a charaid ùr, Fred, a thoirt gu cruinneachaidh-cluich an sgioba. Ge-tà ‘s e deargann a th’ ann am Fred ‘s chan eil càch cho toilichte a leithid fhaicinn nam measg... gus an seall Fred g’ eil e feumail na dhòigh fhèin! Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today’s playdate, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea! However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha bràmair aig Bernie ‘s tha i gus tighinn gu dìnnear a-nochd! Ge-tà, chan eil dad a dh'fhios aig Bernie dè chuireas e air dòigh! Tha Oona ‘s Baba ag aontachadh a chuideachadh ach, le Mossy nam meag, saoil am bi biadh air fhàgail mus nochd i? Bernie has a girlfriend – and she’s on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her! Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Tha Fuigheag a’ faighinn trèat ’son a cho-là-breith an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, chan eil cùisean ag obrachadh a-mach, mar bu chòir! Fuigheag is getting a birthday treat today, but things don’t work out as they should!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich. Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Maigheach, Sionnach, Comhachag agus Tosg a’ faighinn cuireadh gu geama croquet còmhla ri Feòrag. Cò tha a’ nochdadh gun fhiathachadh ach Seoc! Chan eil diù aige do riaghailtean agus tha e a’ milleadh a’ ghnothaich air càch. Dìreach mus fheum iad uile sguir a chluich tha Maigheach a’ cur car anns na riaghailtean agus a’ toirt a chreidsinn air Seoc gu bheil e ri cealgaireachd an uair a tha e ann an dha-rìribh a’ cluich a’ gheama dìreach mar bu chòir. Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too. But being a villain, he can’t stand rules and ruins the game for everyone. Just at the moment the friends are about to give up, Hare reverses the rules to make Jack think he’s cheating but in fact he’s playing the game perfectly.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Gus nach tachair an aon rud a-màireach, ithidh Pompon biadh “glan” gus nach bi aige ri fhiaclan a ghlanadh. Ach a' cheist mhòr: a bheil a leithid a rud ann ri biadh glan? Pompon missed the sun rising as he had to clean his teeth. To avoid the same happening tomorrow, Pompon decides to eat 'clean' food so as to avoid brushing his teeth. But is there such a thing as 'clean' food?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Angela NicAoidh a’ leughadh Rionnag ann an Sileagan. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Sam Hay agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Angela Mackay reads Rionnag ann an Sileagan, written and illustrated by Sam Hay and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag a’ cur Laraidh os cionn an taigh-bìdh rè ùine. Mr Krabs makes Larry the Lobster temporary manager.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Latha eile aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche agus tha Mrs NicArtair air tàlant ùr a lorg sa chlas ealain aice. Chan eil an Tidsear Stiùiridh, Mgr Hobson, cinnteach gur e tàlant a th’ air cùlaibh na h-ealaine ach ma dh'fhaoidte trioblaid! Aig an aon àm, tha Mgr Mackle a’ dèanamh oidhirp a bhith nas fhallaine. Mrs MacArthur has unearthed a new talent in her art class. Mr Hobson is not so sure if it is talent or perhaps a more troubling issue that’s behind the artwork. Meanwhile, Mr Mackle is busy with a new health kick.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha pàrantan Munchkin air earbs’ a chur ann, an cafaidh aca a ruith ’son a’ chiad turas, is chan eil e ’son fàiligeadh. Ri linn sin, tha Tabaidh is Flix ‘son a chuideachadh le obair-frithealaidh – ach saoil am bith iad feumail dha? Munchkin’s parents put their faith in him to run their cafe for the first time, and he doesn’t want to fail. As a result, Tabaidh and Flix want to help with serving, but will they be of any use?

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Cuirm na Granndachd a’ gabhail àit’ far am faigh iad a mach cò as gràinnde de na Bògaisean. Ach cò an Gumbal a tha na Ghumbal nam Beachd? The Ugly Pageant is taking place where they decide on the ugliest Bògais. But which Gumbal is the Ideas-gumbal?

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bonns a-muigh a’ lorg biadh airson na bangaid meadhan-oidhche, tha na Cnuimhean ga ghlacadh ’s ga chur am bruid. Ciamar a gheibh e air adhart an dèidh sin? When Bonns is out finding food for his 12-course midnight snack, the Cnuimhean catch and kidnap him. How will he get on after that?

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Fillte, goes on a journey throughout Scotland to discover the history, and contemporary hand-crafted practice behind the artisan producers of woven fabrics, such as wool, hemp, linen, grasses, leather, and many more unorthodox fabrics. Tha Fillte a gabhail turas tro Alba a’ sireadh eachdraidh agus sgeulachdan an latha ’n diugh co-cheangailte ris an luchd-ciùird a tha snìomh ‘s ag obrachadh diofar stuthan, leithid, clòimh, corcach, anart, feur,leathar, agus iomadh seorsa stuth iongantach eile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na ciad ceumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Coinnichidh sinn ris an neach-ionnsachaidh Sophie Day às an Eaglais Bhreac, agus tha Calum MacIlleathain a’ lorg ìomhaigh ann an uamh air Eilean Dà Bharra far Maol Chinn Tìre. Joy Dunlop continues to guide us through the first basic steps to speak Gaelic. We meet learner Sophie Day from Falkirk, and Calum Maclean keeps a keen eye on the tide whilst on the hunt for spectacular cave art on Davaar Island in the Mull of Kintyre.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Farpais-cheist do-chreidsinneach... Mas Fhìor! Le ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin, ’s iad an fheadhainn a chuireas na ceistean agus na freagairtean. An urrainn do Kerrie is Ceitidh agus Beniamin is Calum a tha a’ cluich bhon stiùideo, a’ chùis a dhèanamh orra airson an duais mhòr a bhuannachadh? A quiz show that is pretty unbelievable! Eight pretenders play from the comfort of their own homes and hold all the questions and answers to this quiz. Can Kerry and Katie, with Benjamin and Calum in the studio, beat the Pretenders for a chance to win a cash prize? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Na tha e ciallachadh a bhith dol tro làn-sgur fuil-mìosa san là an-diugh. What it means to go through the menopause today.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: The community gathers for a fundraiser ceilidh for Old Mary who is recovering from her mill accident. A drunken Boyd confronts Mairead and Cairistiona in front of everyone at the ceilidh. Things turn sour between Johan and Murdina resulting in a mysterious fire starting at the hotel, trapping Murdina and Boyd inside. Will they make it out alive? Tha a’ choimhearsnachd a’ cruinneachadh aig cèilidh gus airgead a thogail do Mhàiri, a tha fhathast a’ faighinn seachad air an tubaist aice ‘sa mhuileann. Tha smùid air Boyd ‘s e a’ cur aghaidh air Mairead ‘s Cairistiona air beulaibh a h-uile duine aig a’ chèilidh. Tha cùisean a’ dol ceàrr eadar Johan is Murdina, a’ fàgail gu bheil teine a’ tòiseachadh anns an taigh-òsta – le Murdina agus Boyd glaiste na bhroinn. Am faigh iad às beò? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Tha Ramsay MacMahon ag ionnsachadh mu bheatha air a’ chrìoch eadar an Fhionnlainn agus an Ruis. Bho thug an Ruis ionnsaigh air an Ucràin ann an 2022 tha a’ chrìoch air dùnadh gu tur, ag atharrachadh beatha dhaoine air gach taobh. Anns an Fhionnlainn, cluinnidh Ramsay sgeulachdan bho theaghlaichean a chaidh a’ sgaradh bho an luchd-gràdh air taobh eile na crìche. Coinnichidh e riuthsan air a bheil an dleastanas ‘son tèarainteachd aig a’ chrìoch agus cluinnidh e bho dhaoine a chaill am beòshlaint’ gu h-obann air sgàth an dùnaidh. Ramsay MacMahon learns about life along the border between Finland and Russia. Since Russia’s attack on Ukraine in 2022 the border has closed completely, transforming the lives of people on both sides. In Finland, Ramsay hears the stories of families who have been separated from their loved ones on the other side, meets those responsible for securing the border and hears from people who have lost their livelihood overnight because of its closure. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Alba and Nelson Mandela ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Alba and Nelson Mandela in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. It’s an upstairs-downstairs, girls v boys clean-off where the winner gets the contract. Things get messy, featuring stains, smudges and romantic complications. The timing isn’t perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie’s infamous disastrous reality TV appearance. Meanwhile, Betty and Dido are on a publicity push where they ditch leaflets and embrace dancing on social media. And Daniel makes a new furry friend as he gets busy with his air freshener.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Tha Fuigheag a’ faighinn trèat ’son a cho-là-breith an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, chan eil cùisean ag obrachadh a-mach, mar bu chòir! Fuigheag is getting a birthday treat today, but things don’t work out as they should!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Maigheach, Sionnach, Comhachag agus Tosg a’ faighinn cuireadh gu geama croquet còmhla ri Feòrag. Cò tha a’ nochdadh gun fhiathachadh ach Seoc! Chan eil diù aige do riaghailtean agus tha e a’ milleadh a’ ghnothaich air càch. Dìreach mus fheum iad uile sguir a chluich tha Maigheach a’ cur car anns na riaghailtean agus a’ toirt a chreidsinn air Seoc gu bheil e ri cealgaireachd an uair a tha e ann an dha-rìribh a’ cluich a’ gheama dìreach mar bu chòir. Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too. But being a villain, he can’t stand rules and ruins the game for everyone. Just at the moment the friends are about to give up, Hare reverses the rules to make Jack think he’s cheating but in fact he’s playing the game perfectly.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Gus nach tachair an aon rud a-màireach, ithidh Pompon biadh “glan” gus nach bi aige ri fhiaclan a ghlanadh. Ach a' cheist mhòr: a bheil a leithid a rud ann ri biadh glan? Pompon missed the sun rising as he had to clean his teeth. To avoid the same happening tomorrow, Pompon decides to eat 'clean' food so as to avoid brushing his teeth. But is there such a thing as 'clean' food?

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha Daolag-bhreac air bhioran – an e àite draoidheil a tha seo? E fèir mìorbhaileach! Daolag-bhreac is excited - is this a magic place? It’s just amazing!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ’S e latha air leth fliuch a th’ ann, is tha Àtaidh a’ lorg toll ann am mullach an taighe. An uair sin tha e a’ mothachadh gu bheil tuill ann an tòrr rudan san taigh aige. Tha e a’ co-dhùnadh toll a chladhach dha fhèin, ach tha e a' steigeadh ann! Ciamar a gheibh Tilidh, Nìp agus na Boga-bogadaich às e? It is a very rainy day and Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own but gets stuck in it! How will Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs get him out?

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan and Gran find a mysterious old carved piece of wood while they are beachcombing. Is it from the wreck of Porthole Pete or a carving of a mermaid? Tha Dan is Gran a' lorg seann phìos fiodha dìomhair a tha snaidht', fhad 's a tha 'd ri lorg-mhuraig. Bheil e ceangailt' ri tubaist mhara seann Peadar a' Phuirt Bhàin, no 'n e maighdeann-mhara shnaidht' a th' ann?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ leughadh Daoine Beaga, Aislingean Mòra: Ella Fitzgerald. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Sanchez Vegara agus a dhealbhachadh le Maria Isabel. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Eilidh Cormack reads Daoine Beaga, Aislingean Mòra: Ella Fitzgerald by Sanchez Vegara, illustrated by Maria Isabel and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha rudeigin dìomhair mun nighean ùr a th’ air an t-sràid – agus dè an gnothach a th’ aice ri trom-laighe Dhaibhidh? Tha Hilda airson a chuideachadh gus am faigh e seachad air an eagal a th’ air aig àm cadail. There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street. And what does she have to do with Daibhidh’s nightmares? Hilda wants to help him get over his fear of night time.

programme.title: Dùbhlain CBBC Alba
programme.desc: Hannah NicKirdy le sùil air ais air cuid de na dùbhlain a chaidh fheuchainn air CBBC ALBA san ùine a chaidh seachad. Hannah McKirdy takes a look at some of the crazy challenges attempted by the CBBC Alba team, including some very competitive cabbage rolling!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Tha Olaidh agus Coinneach ann an Ruisia agus chan e dìreach sgìtheadh a tha a’ gabhail àite oir tha sinn a’ faicinn tanca, saighdearan a’ caismeachd agus…. geama leigeil-shaighdear? Olaidh and Coinneach are in Russia but skiing isn’t the only thing that’s going on - there’s a tank to be seen, soldiers marching and....a game of skittles?

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Denis 10 bliadhna a dh'aois. Tha fadachd mhòr air gus am bi e cheart cho comasach is fèillmhor ri a bhràthair mòr, Marcus. Ge-tà, le beagan oidhirp’, tha Denis a’ sealltainn dhaibh uile g’ eil e cheart cho tàlantach, na dhòigh fhèin! Denis is ten years old. He is desperate to be as capable and popular as his older brother, Marcus. However, with a bit of effort, Denis shows everyone that he is equally talented, in his own way!

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ feuchainn rud a-mach às an àbhaist ‘s a’ dèanamh biadh bhèagan. The lads venture out of their comfort zone and go plant-based.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Musician and learner Andrew Findlater joins Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean takes an earthly walk, provoking thoughts of space and the galaxies around us.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress, turned interior designer, Erica Macpherson, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Duncan Mackenzie - Dileab a' Ghlinne
programme.desc: Dealas stàcair do dhachaigh a shinnsearan ann an Gleann Inbhir Làthail faisg air Ulapul. Local historian and deerstalker Duncan Mackenzie’s passion for Inverlael Glen, near Ullapool.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Na tha e ciallachadh a bhith dol tro làn-sgur fuil-mìosa san là an-diugh. What it means to go through the menopause today.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Taghadh den ceòl is òrain bhon seinneadairean 's luchd-ciùil a bha an sàs san t-sreath. A selection of music and song from the series.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 68 air a sheinn le Norrie MacÌomhair agus Sìneag Nic an t-Saoir, an laoidh Mìorbhail Ghràis le Màiri Nic Aonghais agus bidh Donna Barden ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Psalm 68 sung by Norrie MacIver, the hymn Mìorbhail Ghràis by Mairi MacInnes and Donna Barden tells her personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Sondheim at the BBC
programme.desc: A celebration of the work of one of the great songwriters and lyricists, Stephen Sondheim, who passed away in November 2021 at the age of 91. A giant of musical theatre, Sondheim first found international fame in 1957 as the lyricist for Leonard Bernstein’s West Side Story and would inspire generations from that moment on. This selection includes some of Sondheim’s finest songs, broadcast on the BBC over a period of 60 years, with performances from a cast of his friends and fans that features some of the biggest names of stage and screen, including Shirley Bassey, Sammy Davis Jr, Michael Ball and Liza Minnelli.

programme.desc: Were the ancient Scottish tribes too much for the Roman Empire? Or was Scotland simply not worth conquering? Archaeologist Dr Fraser Hunter looks back on three centuries of contact and conflict with Scotland’s Roman invaders. The first Tay Bridge, the first depiction of tartan and forgotten Roman camps that once held 35,000 men. A story of a superpower pitted against tribesmen and warlords, and one with fascinating modern parallels.

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: The final, dramatic act of the Stuart century saw the Stuarts fatally divided by religion: brother versus brother, and two daughters supporting the overthrow of their father. After Charles II's brother, the Catholic James VII and II, was deposed by protestant William of Orange in 1688, Britain became a constitutional monarchy. However, the so-called 1688 'Glorious Revolution' came at a price, as Scotland lost her sovereignty and became part of Great Britain in 1707, whilst Ireland had been reduced from a kingdom to a colony. The politics of resentment has continued to trouble Ireland until the present day.

programme.title: Voyage to Mars: The Longest Goodbye
programme.desc: Nasa intends to send astronauts to Mars. To succeed, crew members will have to overcome unprecedented, life-threatening challenges, and while many of these hazards are physical, the most elusive are psychological. Throughout the expected three-year absence, crew members won’t be able to communicate with Earth in real time due to the immense distance. The psychological impact of this level of disconnectedness and isolation – both from mission control and loved ones – is impossible to predict and endangers the mission itself. Directed to mitigate this threat is Dr Al Holland, a Nasa psychologist whose job is to keep astronauts mentally stable in space. The Longest Goodbye follows Holland, rookie astronauts Kayla Barron and Matthias Maurer and former astronaut Cady Coleman, among others, as they grapple with the tension between their dream of reaching new frontiers and the basic human need to stay connected to home.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: As Grand Theft Auto VI is released after more than a decade of development and many months of hype, we look at how a Scottish video game became one of the world's most successful, and most profitable, entertainment franchises. We talk to Brian Baglow who worked on the original GTA title and now leads the Scottish Games Network and Cara Ellison who worked on GTA IV and is now an award-winning games developer. Ian Rumsey from ITN tells us about his role as CEO of one of the UK's biggest TV news providers. The rise of social media is reshaping how court cases are reported. Media law expert Sian Harrison and criminal barrister Andrew Taylor assess how online influencers are entering courtrooms, the challenges this poses for contempt of court laws and how digital commentary by high-profile defendants is testing long-standing legal boundaries.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: Could an AI ever be conscious? And if it were, how would we know? Thomas Germain and Jessica Maddox put the question to philosopher Jeff Sebo, director of the Center for Mind, Ethics, and Policy at New York University. Jeff isn't claiming AI is conscious, and he's clear that nobody knows for sure. His argument is that the possibility is real enough to study properly and plan for now, rather than scrambling after the fact as we did with animals and the climate. He explains what consciousness and sentience actually mean, why 'it's just software' doesn't settle the matter, and why the very idea makes so many people so angry. Thomas and Jess push back with the big objections. Shouldn't we fix the problems facing humans first? And can we trust AI companies to give us straight answers?

After scammers stole thousands from her in a devious bank scam two years ago, Denise is teaming up with Scam Interceptors to turn the tables. In this special episode, airing as part of BBC Scam Safe week, Denise joins Rav Wilding and the team to expose the global web of criminals targeting UK victims, including those taking advantage of her identity. Using the same remote access tech scammers rely on, the team hacks the hackers to monitor their operations in real time, before confronting them. Denise also uses voice-changing technology to have fun at the scammers’ expense.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When one of Nottingham’s oldest businesses is broken into, staff member Becca turns Miss Marple and manages to crack the case. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan shows two residents of the doorbell detective neighbourhood the elaborate lengths thieves will go to, to get their hands on your stuff. And Matt also hears from two friends whose life savings disappeared overnight when their food truck was stolen.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman is in glorious Gloucestershire with Sam and Mandy, who are moving from a harbour town in Devon and making a fresh start in the countryside, with their two much-loved dogs coming along for the adventure. With £475,000 to spend, Nicki serves up a terrific selection of homes, but it’s the mystery house that really raises the stakes, with views so spectacular they feel like they’re standing on top of the world. From one grand outlook to another, Nicki gets an exclusive invitation to experience horticulture on a truly regal scale when she visits a garden quite literally fit for a king.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero. The boys answer a distress call from Swindon, where a plane-shaped bench paying tribute to the town’s aviation history is no longer fit to fly. A local woodworking group have taken on the task of fixing it, but they’re in need of some assistance from master carpenter Will. Meanwhile, Dom meets Tulsi, who has a Hindu holy scripture passed down from her grandmother that’s now so fragile it can’t be opened without further damage. It will take every trick in the book if paper conservator Angie is to get this beloved tome back to a state where the family can use it once again. One of the great joys of leaving the barn is the chance for our experts to meet some of the passionate makers around the country keeping heritage crafts alive. programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: Chinese mother Yang Hu finds reassurance in a Japanese word that helps her connect with others while navigating cultural differences in Tokyo.

programme.title: Impacts: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: Due to global warming, the bamboo habitat range in Japan is expanding and abandoned bamboo groves are encroaching on forests and farmland nationwide. How should we associate with this iconic plant?

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Fukasawa Naoto (Product designer) visits Shimane. Red 'Sekishu' roof tiles are perfectly suited to cold, snowy regions. Fukasawa considers design that embodies the community it comes from.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: Join us as we visit a factory where they produce the freshest, crunchiest pre-cut, pre-packed vegetables. Find out the 'dark arts' of mung bean sprout cultivation, and just why they're so cheap.

programme.title: Yonezawa
programme.desc: Since ancient times, safflowers grown in Yonezawa have been used to dye fabric a deep red colour associated with the sun. Experience its mysterious, vivid beauty through time-lapse footage.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato
programme.desc: A series of poetic videos by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara, in collaboration with a pianist, Mine Kawakami, for which she plays exclusive pieces, makes you experience each seasons.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Tokyo Skytree, one of Japan's most famous tourist attractions, is equipped with many countermeasures against disasters. We'll explore the tower's advanced technologies.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture. This episode looks at words related to the night. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Easy Japanese
programme.desc: #48 When I graduate, I want to work in Japan. / To explain your plan, say a verb in the 'ta' form followed by 'ra,' to indicate the circumstance, and then whatever your plan is.

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: Hana no Kai is an elderly day care facility in Kobe that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. It makes the lives of those living out their final years in a foreign land more active and dignified.

programme.title: Queen of the Damned
programme.desc: Follows the legendary vampire Lestat (Stuart Townsend), who has reinvented himself as a rock star in the contemporary American music scene. His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat.

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love.

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, soldier Luc Deveraux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds that his superior officer, Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren), has turned violently deranged, and the two fight to the death. After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Deveraux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is.

programme.title: Uncommon Valor
programme.desc: Col. Cal Rhodes (Gene Hackman), a retired Marine officer, holds out hope that his son, believed to be a prisoner of war in Laos, is still alive. Despite the government's refusal to help Rhodes, he assembles a group to find and rescue his son, including skilled soldiers such as Wilkes (Fred Ward) and Sailor (Randall "Tex" Cobb). Funded by MacGregor (Robert Stack), a wealthy executive also looking for his son, Rhodes leads his men on a dangerous mission into the jungles of Laos.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world.

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby
programme.desc: A young wife comes to believe that her offspring is not of this world. Waifish Rosemary Woodhouse and her struggling actor husband Guy move to a New York City apartment building with an ominous reputation and odd neighbors Roman and Minnie Castevet. When Rosemary becomes pregnant, she becomes increasingly isolated, and the diabolical truth is revealed only after Rosemary gives birth.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

When Olsen returns from the war, he and Vivienne must confront and make peace with the person each has become.

programme.title: The Cut

programme.title: Due Justice

Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma.

Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator.

programme.title: All Is Lost
programme.desc: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran mariner (Robert Redford) awakes to find his vessel taking on water after a collision with a stray shipping container. With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life. With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own mortality.

programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

programme.title: I Was a Stranger
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.

programme.title: Pike River
programme.desc: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible.

programme.title: Yellowjackets
programme.desc: A team of talented high school girls soccer players survives a plane crash deep in the remote northern wilderness.

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

programme.title: Sleepless
programme.desc: Undercover Las Vegas police officer Vincent Downs (Jamie Foxx) finds himself caught in a high-stakes web of corrupt cops, internal affairs and murderous gangsters. When a failed heist leads to the kidnapping of his teenage son (Octavius J. Johnson), Downs must race against time during a wild and restless night to save him and bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple).

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Ballistic
programme.desc: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood.

programme.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
programme.desc: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies.

programme.title: Due Date
programme.desc: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan.

programme.title: Night on Earth
programme.desc: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest.

programme.title: Papillon
programme.desc: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, a safecracker from the Parisian underworld who is framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an unlikely alliance with convicted counterfeiter Louis Dega, who in exchange for protection, agrees to finance Papillon's escape.

programme.title: The Way, Way Back
programme.desc: Duncan (Liam James) is an awkward teen who must spend the summer at a beach house with his mother (Toni Collette), her boyfriend, Trent (Steve Carell), and Trent's obnoxious daughter. Trent can't resist badgering Duncan, so the youth steals away to a water park and gets a job that will help him stay off Trent's radar. As Duncan tends to the slides and pools of the aging park, he finds a father figure in wisecracking park manager Owen (Sam Rockwell) at a time when he desperately needs one.

programme.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
programme.desc: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam.

programme.title: Architecton
programme.desc: A hypnotic, propulsive odyssey through the foundations of the modern world, following mountains as they are turned into concrete and buildings as they are turned into rubble.

programme.title: Broken City
programme.desc: Former cop Billy Taggart (Mark Wahlberg) sees a chance at redemption for past sins when New York City's Mayor Nicolas Hostetler (Russell Crowe) calls on him for a special job. Hostetler thinks his wife, Cathleen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is having an affair and that it may hurt his chances for re-election. However, a bigger scandal than expected pulls in Billy right at the start of his investigation. Double-crossed by the mayor, Billy begins a relentless quest for justice.

programme.title: The Darkest Minds
programme.desc: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

programme.title: The Judge
programme.desc: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man.

programme.title: Hidden Figures
programme.desc: Three brilliant African American women at NASA, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson, serve as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history, the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, a stunning achievement that restored the nation's confidence, turned around the Space Race and galvanized the world.

programme.title: X-Men: First Class
programme.desc: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart.

programme.title: Rampage
programme.desc: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe.

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown.

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner.

programme.title: The Art of Getting By
programme.desc: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix.

programme.title: Time Bandits
programme.desc: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century.

programme.title: DC League of Super-Pets
programme.desc: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission.

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

programme.title: Gimme Shelter
programme.desc: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco.

programme.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
programme.desc: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era.

programme.title: MacGruber
programme.desc: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice.

programme.title: Friendship
programme.desc: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor.

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

programme.desc: Cameron Mathison co-hosts; actress Kyla Pratt; actors David McCormack and Melanie Zanetti.

programme.desc: Delivering the news that matters most.

programme.desc: Revisiting the 2006 Duke lacrosse rape case, a story that exposed the consequences of media frenzy.

programme.desc: The team investigates the murder of a tech founder obsessed with life extension.

programme.desc: As Thanksgiving kicks off in Port Charles, Drew and Ava are stunned by an unexpected visitor.

programme.title: ABC World News Tonight With David Muir New
programme.desc: Delivering the news that matters most.

programme.title: Dancing With the Stars New
programme.desc: The five remaining couples take on the most demanding finale yet.

programme.title: Jimmy Kimmel Live! New
programme.sub-title: Joel McHale; Travis Barker; Violet Grohl; Maggie Rose
programme.desc: Joel McHale; Travis Barker; Violet Grohl performs; Maggie Rose sits in with The Cletones.

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

programme.title: Blue Valentine
programme.desc: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: Christmas Takes Flight
programme.desc: A number-crunching CEO buys a family-owned airline and cancels the airline's annual holiday charitable benefit. A pilot rallies the community to help save the event and unexpectedly finds herself falling for the magnate in the process.

programme.title: Comet
programme.desc: A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower.

programme.title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
programme.desc: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Hugo
programme.desc: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler.

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: In the Los Angeles Police Department, Officer Dennis Peck (Richard Gere) is a divisive figure, loved by those who are loyal to him and looked on with suspicion by others. His disreputable behavior and dubious finances arouse the suspicion of Internal Affairs, and Sgt. Raymond Avila (Andy Garcia) and his partner (Laurie Metcalf) are assigned to investigate. When a series of witnesses are murdered, Avila realizes his life is in danger, along with that of his wife (Nancy Travis).

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done.

programme.title: Buddymoon
programme.desc: After he is dumped at the altar, a former child star's best friend takes him on a backpacking trek in the remote mountains of Oregon.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: One of an elite group of assassins, Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) may be the best in the business. Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership.

programme.title: Hugo
programme.desc: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: A Perfect Murder
programme.desc: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect.

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family.

programme.title: DC League of Super-Pets
programme.desc: Krypto the Super-Dog and a ragtag group of animals must save Superman and the Justice League.

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: A mild-mannered college professor investigates the life of an actor who looks exactly like him.

programme.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
programme.desc: An ancient Celtic ritual drives Dr. Loomis' patient to sacrifice an entire family in Illinois.

programme.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
programme.desc: A woman's (Jamie Lee Curtis) lethal brother returns for her 20 years later.

programme.title: Halloween: Resurrection
programme.desc: Collegians spend the night in Michael Myers' (Brad Loree) childhood home.

programme.title: Happy Death Day
programme.desc: A collegian must relive the day of her murder over and over until she figures out who killed her.

programme.title: Atomic Blonde
programme.desc: A spy travels to Berlin to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring.

programme.title: Solace
programme.desc: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

programme.title: Adult Best Friends
programme.desc: Katie takes her best friend on a trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married.

programme.title: Game Night
programme.desc: A murder mystery party turns into a wild and chaotic night for a group of unsuspecting couples.

Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Deveraux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict.

programme.title: 68 Kill

So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is.

programme.title: Uncommon Valor

Despite the government's refusal to help Rhodes, he assembles a group to find and rescue his son, including skilled soldiers such as Wilkes (Fred Ward) and Sailor (Randall "Tex" Cobb). Funded by MacGregor (Robert Stack), a wealthy executive also looking for his son, Rhodes leads his men on a dangerous mission into the jungles of Laos.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2

After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

When Lila gets better, she asks Snoopy to live with her. After a farewell party, he sets out to live with Lila, leaving Charlie Brown depressed.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

programme.title: Ballistic
programme.desc: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: The Back-up Plan
programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Ethan, Abi and Sam attend a funeral for an old friend from university; the funeral brings their love and loneliness to the surface; Abi reflects on her relationship with Tom; Ethan pursues Aaron; and Sam wrestles with her guilt.

programme.title: It Gets Worse
programme.desc: Ethan, Abi and Sam attempt to reconcile, but the new chapter only reveals that their messy lives are far from resolved; surely it gets better than this, right? But who needs better, when they have each other?

programme.title: Hostage
programme.desc: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: Hard Rain
programme.desc: The small town of Huntingburg is forced to evacuate when torrential rains bring rising floodwaters. The local sheriff and town residents, having been through this before, are all too familiar with the looting and petty thefts that take place in an abandoned town. What they are not aware of, however, is the planned heist of an armored car sent to transport the $3 million from local banks.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a nightclub singer and a 12-year-old boy.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: An art collector appeals to Jones to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. He learns that another archaeologist has disappeared while searching for the precious goblet, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry Jones. The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart.

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery.

In the blistering Australian outback, the only way to efficiently round up cattle herds on vast farms is through the use of helicopter cowboys like Chris Weyand.

programme.title: The Story of Scottish Art

programme.title: Classic Mastermind

programme.title: Saving Venice
